title: Grabbing Inflation Protection Now Is a No-Brainer
title_zh: 現在買進抗通膨保護是再明顯不過的選擇
subtitle: 現在買進抗通膨保護是再明顯不過的選擇
author: James Mackintosh

sentences.en: Grabbing Inflation Protection Now Is a No-Brainer.
sentences.zh: 現在買進抗通膨保護，是再明顯不過的選擇。

sentences.en: F. Scott Fitzgerald once defined a first-rate intelligence as the ability to hold two opposed ideas in mind at the same time.
sentences.zh: 史考特・費茲傑羅曾把一流智力定義為：能同時在腦中容納兩個對立想法的能力。

sentences.en: Few think there will be a recession anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 幾乎沒有人認為近期會出現衰退。

sentences.en: And although the U.S. economy has been running hot, almost nobody thinks inflation is a long-term threat.
sentences.zh: 而且儘管美國經濟一直處於過熱狀態，幾乎沒有人把通膨看成長期威脅。

sentences.en: The result: Juicy real yields are available for anyone inclined to worry.
sentences.zh: 結果是：任何傾向於擔心的人，現在都能拿到豐厚的實質殖利率。

sentences.en: Even the recent tumble in artificial-intelligence stocks and ignominious exit of AI cheerleader Jensen Huang from Nvidia hasn’t hurt confidence in growth.
sentences.zh: 即使最近人工智慧股票大跌，加上 AI 啦啦隊長黃仁勳不光彩地離開輝達，也沒有動搖市場對成長的信心。

sentences.en: Economically-sensitive cyclical sectors of the S&P 500 have risen nicely since the start of October, on an equal-weight basis and leaving out tech.
sentences.zh: 自 10 月初以來，標普 500 中對景氣敏感的循環類股，在等權重且不含科技股的基礎上漲勢不錯。

sentences.en: The AI fall didn’t dent confidence in the U.S. economy, it just led to a rotation out of AI.
sentences.zh: AI 股下跌並沒有削弱人們對美國經濟的信心，只是引發資金從 AI 輪動出去。

sentences.en: There was a moderation in those predicting a boom—but 41% still expect it to continue, from 47% a month before.
sentences.zh: 預期榮景將延續的人比重有所下降——但仍有 41% 這麼認為，一個月前是 47%。

sentences.en: The same survey suggested fund managers don’t yet find Treasurys attractive.
sentences.zh: 同一份調查顯示，基金經理人目前仍不覺得美國公債有吸引力。

sentences.en: The 10-year break-even rate, the market’s best guess of inflation over the next decade, is at 2.16%, basically in line with the Federal Reserve’s target.
sentences.zh: 10 年期損益兩平通膨率（市場對未來十年通膨的最佳估計）目前是 2.16%，大致符合聯準會的目標。

sentences.en: Three things could go wrong: Higher rates cause a slowdown, the boom leads to even-more-stubborn inflation or investors realize high yields combined with high stock valuations mean bonds deserve a second look.
sentences.zh: 有三件事可能出差錯：利率升高導致經濟放緩、榮景讓通膨更加居高不下，或投資人意識到高殖利率加上高股市估值，意味著債券值得再看一眼。

sentences.en: This is fractionally below the high at the start of October.
sentences.zh: 這只略低於 10 月初的高點。

sentences.en: If the strong economy prompts the Fed to keep hiking, real yields could go higher still, and Tips holders would be in the red.
sentences.zh: 如果強勁的經濟促使聯準會繼續升息，實質殖利率還可能再往上走，TIPS 持有人就會陷入虧損。

sentences.en: Hold Tips to maturity and you get inflation plus almost 3% for a decade.
sentences.zh: 把 TIPS 持有到期，十年間你就能拿到通膨再加將近 3% 的報酬。

vocab.zh: 再明顯不過的選擇；不用想也知道的事
vocab.usage: a no-brainer 不必猶豫的決定；It’s a no-brainer. 這還用說嗎
vocab.example: Taking the paid internship was a no-brainer.
vocab.example_zh: 接受這個有薪實習是再明顯不過的選擇。

vocab.usage: two opposed ideas 兩個對立的想法；be opposed to… 反對…
vocab.example: The two parties have opposed views on tax cuts.
vocab.example_zh: 兩黨對減稅持對立的看法。

vocab.usage: a recession 一場衰退；enter / slip into a recession 陷入衰退
vocab.example: Many families cut spending during a recession.
vocab.example_zh: 許多家庭在衰退期間會減少開支。

vocab.usage: the economy is running hot 經濟過熱；也可用來形容引擎或機器過熱
vocab.example: When the economy is running hot, prices often rise faster.
vocab.example_zh: 經濟過熱時，物價往往漲得更快。

vocab.usage: juicy yields / returns 豐厚的殖利率／報酬；口語用法
vocab.example: The startup offered juicy bonuses to attract engineers.
vocab.example_zh: 那家新創提供豐厚獎金來吸引工程師。

vocab.usage: a tumble in stock prices 股價大跌；動詞 tumble 也是「下跌」
vocab.example: A tumble in oil prices hurt energy stocks.
vocab.example_zh: 油價大跌拖累了能源股。

vocab.usage: 正式用語；an ignominious exit / defeat 不光彩的退場／慘敗
vocab.example: The team suffered an ignominious defeat in the final.
vocab.example_zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中遭遇不光彩的慘敗。

vocab.usage: cyclical sectors / stocks 循環類股；名詞也可指這類股票
vocab.example: Auto sales are highly cyclical.
vocab.example_zh: 汽車銷售的景氣循環性很強。

vocab.usage: dent confidence / profits 打擊信心／獲利；名詞 dent 是「凹痕、缺口」
vocab.example: The scandal did not dent his popularity.
vocab.example_zh: 這件醜聞並沒有削弱他的人氣。

vocab.usage: a rotation out of tech 資金從科技股輪動出去；sector rotation 類股輪動
vocab.example: Investors made a rotation into bank stocks.
vocab.example_zh: 投資人把資金輪動進銀行股。

vocab.usage: a moderation in growth 成長趨緩；in moderation 適量地
vocab.example: There was a moderation in food-price increases.
vocab.example_zh: 食品價格的漲勢有所趨緩。

vocab.usage: WSJ 常用 Treasurys，一般寫成 Treasuries；buy Treasurys 買美債
vocab.example: Some investors moved cash into Treasurys.
vocab.example_zh: 有些投資人把現金轉進美國公債。

vocab.usage: the 10-year break-even rate 十年期損益兩平通膨率，代表市場對未來通膨的預期
vocab.example: The break-even rate fell after the jobs report.
vocab.example_zh: 就業報告公布後，損益兩平通膨率下滑。

vocab.usage: stubborn inflation 居高不下的通膨；a stubborn problem 難解的問題
vocab.example: Stubborn inflation makes rate cuts less likely.
vocab.example_zh: 通膨居高不下，降息的可能性就變小。

vocab.usage: high / rich valuations 高估值；stock valuations 股票估值
vocab.example: High valuations leave little room for error.
vocab.example_zh: 高估值讓犯錯的空間變得很小。

vocab.usage: fractionally below / above 略低於／略高於；比 slightly 更正式
vocab.example: The temperature was fractionally higher than yesterday.
vocab.example_zh: 氣溫只比昨天略高一點。

vocab.usage: keep hiking (rates) 繼續升息；rate hike 升息（名詞）
vocab.example: The central bank may keep hiking if prices stay high.
vocab.example_zh: 如果物價持續偏高，央行可能繼續升息。

vocab.usage: be / end up in the red 陷入虧損；反義 in the black 獲利
vocab.example: The restaurant was in the red for two years.
vocab.example_zh: 那家餐廳虧了兩年。

vocab.usage: hold a bond to maturity 持有債券到期；at maturity 到期時
vocab.example: I plan to hold the bond until maturity.
vocab.example_zh: 我打算把這張債券持有到期。

vocab.usage: issue a subpoena 發出傳票；動詞也可：subpoena someone 傳喚某人
vocab.example: The court issued a subpoena for the company records.
vocab.example_zh: 法院發出傳票，要求提供公司紀錄。
